object Relational {
  def f(a: Int, b: Int): Boolean = a < b
  def g(a: Int, b: Int): Boolean = a <= b && a > b || a >= b
  def h(a: Int, b: Int): Boolean = a == b || a != b
  def arrows(xs: List[Int]): List[Int] = for (x <- xs) yield x
  def lambda: Int => Int = x => x
  def bounds[A <: AnyRef, B >: Null](a: A): A = a
  def shifts(a: Int): Int = (a << 2) >> 3 >>> 4
  def method[T](a: T)(implicit ord: Ordering[T]): Boolean = ord.lt(a, a)
}
